req.title: Redirect-to supports custom status codes
req.statement: The system shall honour the 'status_code' query parameter on /redirect-to for values 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the /redirect-to endpoint should support custom status codes 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308. The test suite will verify that the endpoint correctly handles these status codes, ensuring that the system behaves as expected for valid inputs, handles invalid inputs gracefully, and respects boundary conditions.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a valid status_code of 301.
expected: The response status code should be 301.
The Location header should match the provided URL.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=301')
assert response.status_code == 301
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'http://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_invalid_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with an invalid status_code of 400.
expected: The response status code should be 302, as the invalid status code should default to 302.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=400')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'http://example.com'

tests.name: test_redirect_to_boundary_status_code
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to /redirect-to with a boundary status_code of 300.
expected: The response status code should be 302, as 300 is not a valid redirect status code.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=300')
assert response.status_code == 302
assert response.headers['Location'] == b'http://example.com'
